additional_info.subject: RE: ID0456265-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T4170004625] Side foil is coming loose. CRM:03042000077 | EQM 1184150
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
I’m sorry for this finding, we identify that this charger is manufactured in LPZ which unfortunately closed, however you addressed correctly as we’ll also support on these cases
I change slightly the title to reflect the EQM number where the 8D methodology is followed,
Regarding containment action, we’ll reply ASAP with an internally aligned containment action
Regarding the 5w2h on previous replies, I understand that providing all the details for the 5W2H might feel a bit extensive, and I truly appreciate your thoroughness and patience with this process. The reason we lean on this structured approach is that a precise and detailed problem description is often the key to finding the most effective and lasting solution. When we clearly understand the 'What,' 'Why,' 'When,' 'Who,' 'Where,' 'How,' and 'How many,' it helps us not only address the immediate issue but also identify underlying causes for continuous improvement. Think of it this way: the quality of our solution is directly linked to the quality of the information we start with. For example, if we know the issue was detected immediately after unpacking, it might point us towards a potential packaging concern. This kind of specific detail allows us to implement targeted corrective measures, perhaps even improving our packaging process to prevent similar issues in the future, rather than just fixing the symptom.
With best regards,
Luis Miguel Vieira da Silva

SI E SCM CRS QM-QA

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0456265-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP/T4170004625] Side foil is coming loose. CRM:03042000077 | EQM 1184150
additional_info.body:
Hello again,
As a containment, we suggest doing the following
Order the following MLFBs to rework the wrapping cast
8EM5905-0AA00-4AA4-Left
8EM5905-0AA00-4AA5-Right
The overview of the steps for rework are the following
Physically remove the relevant LED of the door, keep in mind these steps of handling by the LED supplier
Also remove any physical equipment that’s attached in the side of the door, i.e. the gunholders, LEM meters(if any), etc.
Examples:
Use the whole wrapping cast, make a smaller hole where the vinyl will set of the “holes” of the gunholders, LEM, etc. and place them in the inside of the charger. As the example of the last picture shared
